name: tourismeontract
description: Decentralized Airbnb-style tourism marketplace with multi-chain smart-contract escrow (EVM, Solana, EOSIO/Antelope)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n chain,deploy,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm run chain" "wait-on tcp:8545 && npm run deploy:local" "wait-on tcp:8545 file:web/src/config/deployments.json && npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.test: npm test -w contracts/evm && npm test -w server
scripts.reset-db: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['tourisme.db','tourisme.db-wal','tourisme.db-shm'])fs.rmSync('server/data/'+f,{force:true});console.log('Database removed - it will be re-seeded on next start')"
